falsifying_cases: A failed or stale receipt becomes promotion eligible.
hypothesis: Frozen local retrieval cases produce repeatable bounded evidence, abstain on unsupported questions, refuse injection and protected effects, and retain failed thresholds without promotion.
independent_verification: A verifier replays canonical local fixtures, resolves every citation, compares repeat outputs, and validates the digest-bound receipt.
proof_limits: Does not prove general answer correctness or model reasoning quality.
Does not invoke a provider, acquire remote data, or activate knowledge.
